title: Red Hat Security Advisory: openssh security update
description: Red Hat has issued a security advisory for OpenSSH addressing multiple vulnerabilities including information disclosure via a shared compression side-channel, arbitrary file write through directory traversal during SFTP recursive copy, credential disclosure via failed GSSAPI authentication, denial of service via oversized decompressed packets, and command injection via unvalidated command-line username. These vulnerabilities affect Red Hat Enterprise Linux 8 across various architectures. The update is rated as having a moderate security impact.
